name: @arrrank/mobile
description: Android and iOS shell for the Rank web application

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @arrrank/web -- --mode mobile && cap sync
scripts.android:apk: tsc -b ../../tsconfig.build.json && npm run build && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:aab: tsc -b ../../tsconfig.build.json && npm run build && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease -PrankRequireSigning=true
